summary: Allows admin users to create, edit, activate, deactivate, and view notification templates used for customer notifications.
useCases: Admin views a list of notification templates
Admin creates a new notification template with name, channel, subject, body, and status
Admin edits an existing notification template
System validates required fields on template creation and update
System enforces that only active templates are used for sending notifications
validations: Name, channel, body, and status fields are required for all templates
Subject field is required if channel is email
Status must be either active or inactive
Only active templates can be used for sending notifications
businessRules: Only admin users can manage notification templates
Only active templates can be used for sending notifications
Deactivating a template prevents it from being used in notifications
openQuestions: What are the valid values for the channel field beyond email? Are SMS and push notifications supported?
Should templates be deletable or only deactivated?
Is there a need for versioning or audit trail of template changes?
Are there any formatting or length restrictions on subject and body fields?
